gbl-battle-2026-10-20.description: First battle, recorded without ManGo. You: Altaria, Mimikyu, Melmetal. Opponent: Stunfisk, Cramorant, Fearow.

notes.1: Rounding to the nearest fast move had given 7; only finished fast moves count when they throw.
notes.7: Fearow came in after Cramorant fainted (both start at 0 turns). You threw 1 fast move then a charged move: both 2-turn moves lined up, so Fearow got 2 Pecks. You threw 2 more then a charged move: 3 more Pecks. Fearow threw 1 more Peck, then Drill Run. Fearow had shielded your Double Iron Bash, and your buttons came back late; since Drill Run can only start as a Peck finishes, ManGo works out that the battle restarted 0.6s before them.

gbl-battle-2026-10-20-mango.description: Second battle, with ManGo's overlay on screen (dragged to the bottom partway through). You: Altaria, Melmetal, Mimikyu. Opponent: Marowak, Sableye (Shadow), Talonflame.

notes.1: The countdown's GO read as "CO"; ManGo on the phone started late and showed 30 instead of 50.
notes.5: ManGo said 8 before freezing at your buttons vanishing rather than at "Get Ready!".

gbl-battle-2026-10-20-v2.description: Third battle, with ManGo's overlay on screen. You: Altaria, Melmetal, Mimikyu. Opponent: Melmetal, Ninetales (Shadow), Altaria (swapping Ninetales and Altaria).

notes.3: Thrown straight away with leftover energy. Melmetal then threw 3 Thunder Shocks and fainted to a fast move. Thrown as soon as the battle restarted, about when your buttons came back.
notes.4: Ninetales threw 2 Embers, you threw Dynamic Punch (both 2-turn moves, lined up) so 1 more slipped in, then 3 more with a 1-turn break between the 5th and 6th. ManGo can't see breaks, so it counts 7.
notes.6: Dragon Breath is too fast to count by eye.
notes.7: Dragon Breath is too fast to count by eye.

gbl-battle-2026-10-20-v3.description: Fourth battle, a Fantasy Cup with ManGo's overlay on screen (covering the opponent's name box much of the time). You: Altaria, Melmetal, Mimikyu. Opponent: Mimikyu, Turtonator, Granbull.

notes.1: Mimikyu led (named from the start's "Go, Mimikyu!") and threw 2 Shadow Claws before switching to Turtonator. Turtonator threw 5 Incinerates.
notes.2: Thrown straight after the first Dragon Claw, in the same stop. Turtonator then switched out to Granbull.
notes.3: Granbull switched in during the stop after Turtonator's Dragon Claws, so it starts as the battle restarts. 7 Charms before Crunch, then 1 that counted when your charged move interrupted it, then 5 that knocked out your Mimikyu and Altaria.

gbl-battle-2026-10-20-v7.description: Seventh battle, with ManGo on screen. Opponent: Azumarill, Empoleon, Magnezone.

notes.1: Empoleon used Waterfall (+10 every 3 turns), not PvPoke's Metal Sound, so ManGo overcounted it; not hand-counted.
notes.3: Includes Azumarill's 1 Bubble as the lead before switching out.

gbl-battle-2026-10-20-v8.description: Eighth battle, with ManGo on screen. Opponent: Azumarill, Lucario, Mawile.

notes.3: Includes Azumarill's 1 Bubble as the lead before switching out.

gbl-battle-2026-10-23-v11.description: Eleventh battle, with ManGo on screen. You: Altaria, Mimikyu, Melmetal. Opponent: Altaria, Mimikyu, Empoleon.

notes.1: You both threw on the same turn (Sky Attack, then Moonblast on charged move priority), so Altaria had no fast move in progress: 13 Dragon Breaths, which your Altaria's HP bar also shows (13 drops).
notes.4: Empoleon threw Hydro Cannon on the same turn as your charged move, which it had shielded.
notes.5: Empoleon's buttons-back restart wasn't late: its own Hydro Cannon, not its shield of yours, ended the stop before.

battle-2026-10-23-132243.description: First battle saved by the phone (its own reads, timed to its video). You: Altaria, Melmetal, Mimikyu. Opponent: Doublade, Togetic, Stunfisk.

notes.1: ManGo used to start the lead's clock at GO's first read (19.89s) and counted 8 Shadow Claws. GO stays on screen a moment before the first turn; starting 0.2s after it gives 7. Your Altaria's HP bar drops 7 times before the stop.

battle-2026-10-23-135548.description: Phone-saved battle. You: Altaria, Melmetal, Mimikyu. Opponent: Turtonator, Florges, Tinkaton.

notes.cmp: At 1:01 you threw after 4 two-turn moves: Florges matched them and sneaked a 5th Fairy Wind (45), as ManGo counts. At 1:10.5 you threw again on the first turn back, on the same turn as Florges's charged move. You won charged move priority and Double Iron Bash knocked it out, so its move never showed and ManGo counted a sneaked Fairy Wind (54). Harmless: Florges was out.

battle-2026-10-23-140441.description: Phone-saved battle. You: Melmetal, Altaria, Mimikyu. Opponent: Turtonator, Mimikyu, Stunfisk.

notes.switch: At 1:09.5 Mimikyu blocked your charged move after throwing Shadow Sneak, and the opponent switched to Turtonator about a second into play: a turn, so Turtonator had 3 Incinerates plus the one in progress (80) at your throw, not 100.
notes.faint: Mimikyu's second time in: Turtonator's Dragon Claw knocked yours out, then they switched to Mimikyu. Your faint makes that a choice, so it costs a turn: 2 Shadow Claws by your throw after 2 Thunder Shocks (38 + 16 = 54). ManGo had made it free (62).

battle-2026-10-23-155712.description: Phone-saved battle. You: Altaria, Melmetal, Mimikyu. Opponent: Flygon, Corviknight, Azumarill.

notes.2: Corviknight threw Payback (60) when ManGo had 56, after your Pokémon fainted at 1:23: at least 1 Sand Attack short.
notes.4: Azumarill threw Ice Beam (55) when ManGo had 44 (4 Bubbles): at least 5. Your Mimikyu's HP bar shows 2 Bubbles after it came in (2:23.5, 2:24.97), as ManGo counts, so the missing one is in the two short stretches after Azumarill replaced the fainted Corviknight. Restarting 0.75s before your buttons after a faint fixes it but breaks other hand counts; rhythm carried through charged moves made it worse (33).

battle-2026-10-23-192858.description: Phone-saved battle. You: Altaria, Melmetal, Mimikyu. Opponent: Corviknight, Turtonator, Mimikyu.

notes.bench: Corviknight (0:45.7) and Turtonator (1:40.6) switched out right after charged moves, which ManGo took for faints and dropped from the bench. Their pokéballs stayed red (opponentAlive added from the video with screen-log --balls).

battle-2026-10-24-220440.description: Phone-saved battle. You: Altaria, Melmetal, Mimikyu. Opponent: Stunfisk (Galarian), Forretress (Shadow), Melmetal.

notes.1: Stunfisk threw Rock Slide (45) on exactly 5 Mud Shots: your Altaria's HP bar drops a pixel at 26.5, 27.5, 28.6, 29.6 and 30.8s. Its first started about 1.2s after GO (the countdown's 2 at 22.7s puts GO at 24.3s; the stylized GO itself wasn't read), so GO + 0.2s gives ManGo a 6th.
